_what: What the Media section lists, as DATA read by src/media-library.mjs. One row per result of `entry_kind` (a recording the person's library knows), with `entry_fields` read from that result; each `joins` row reads more fields from another result kind kept for the same file (`value` reads the path, `json` reads the whole value at the path ("$" is the result itself), `count` counts the list at the path, `words` counts the words of the text at the path); a field several rows name reads the first row that holds a value, so a title the person accepted (kind `title`, src/file-tidy.mjs) wins over the summary's. Every other media file the person keeps is a row too: each file named under one of `file_folders` ("/" holds them all) whose content type's family is one of `media_families`, with that folder's `origin`; the first folder holding a file wins. `origin_labels` names each row's origin as people read it. Adding a field is one row here and a field row on the screen; nothing in the code names a kind.
